auth.nativeCredentialPath: Ordinary host official aliyun explicit profile AK/STS/RAM route. Mac sre-executor MUST use fixed managed wrapper target, no direct aliyun/profile/config/package access.
auth.missingCredentialWorkflow: Ordinary host authorized configure profile/private injection; managed wrapper missing/rejected/mismatched => administrator repairs runtime, never personal/default fallback. No automatic browser device grant.
auth.subjectAndResourcePermissionVerification: Ordinary selected aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity --profile <target> and account match plus scoped read; managed wrapper only approved identity/read capabilities, unknown supported command stays pending.
auth.issuanceConsumptionRevocation: RAM AccessKey disable/delete or STS expiry by authorized owner. Managed executor credentials lifecycle belongs runtime admin, never exported/read.
auth.credentialHandling: Private injection only; never print/store secrets in repository, command arguments, chat or receipts. Discovery itself performs no login/token creation.
